rationale: Sid brings deep product expertise in computer vision and cloud-based B2B platforms from his work on Verkada's physical security stack, while Tuan is building ML and geospatial intelligence applications for solar energy optimization—both leveraging similar technical foundations (computer vision, cloud architecture) in adjacent enterprise domains. Tuan's explicit interest in connecting with climate tech and renewable energy professionals, combined with Sid's PM experience scaling product at a large security platform, could yield useful perspectives on productization, team building, and go-to-market approaches for hardware-software integrations.
intro_message: Sid Dedhia, meet Tuan Van Doan — both of you work at the intersection of computer vision, cloud infrastructure, and B2B enterprise products, and Tuan is actively looking to connect with climate tech professionals who understand product scaling.
